title: 90-day uptime history occasionally showing an incorrect status for a given day

updates.message: Identified that the 90-day history query window wasn't anchored to calendar-day boundaries — the query start/end were computed as "now minus 90 days" rather than fixed UTC midnights, so the specific instant sampled for a given day's bar drifted depending on what time the page happened to load. Root cause confirmed, fix in progress.

Fix deployed to the history adapter — every day's sample is now anchored to UTC midnight, so it's stable regardless of load time. Monitoring over the next few days to confirm historical bars settle to the correct status before marking this resolved.

title: Planned maintenance — full fleet offline for rack rebuild

updates.message: All six Proxmox nodes and the UPS are being powered down for a planned physical rack rebuild — moving the fleet into a new 3D-printed 10-inch 10U rack. This is planned maintenance, not an unplanned outage.
Rebuild complete. All nodes back online and Prometheus scraping resumed. Uptime history for this date correctly shows a gap rather than fabricated data — see the 90-day bars for any service above.
